nodes.description: Immutable address of the ERC20 token distributed by the contract (token).
Immutable merkle root of the tree containing claimable balances (merkleRoot).
Packed mapping(uint256=>uint256) bit map tracking which claim indexes have already been claimed.
Public/external claim(uint256 index, address account, uint256 amount, bytes32[] merkleProof): checks claim status, verifies the proof, marks claimed and transfers tokens.
Public view isClaimed(uint256 index): reads claimedBitMap and returns whether the given index bit is set.
Private _setClaimed(uint256 index): sets the corresponding bit in claimedBitMap.
MerkleProof.verify(bytes32[] proof, bytes32 root, bytes32 leaf): iteratively hashes proof elements and compares the computed hash to the root.
Constructor(address token_, bytes32 merkleRoot_): initializes the immutable token and merkleRoot state variables.
msg.sender / external caller of the unpermissioned claim function.
External call IERC20(token).transfer(account, amount) performing the token payout to the claimant.
Bit-manipulation state write claimedBitMap[claimedWordIndex] | (1 << claimedBitIndex) used to mark an index as claimed.
Parameter index of claim(uint256 index, ...): the leaf index in the merkle tree.
Parameter account of claim(...): the address receiving the tokens.
Parameter amount of claim(...): the quantity of tokens to transfer.
Parameter merkleProof (bytes32[] calldata) used to prove the leaf belongs to the merkle root.
Local bytes32 node = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(index, account, amount)) computed in claim.
Local claimedWordIndex = index / 256 and claimedBitIndex = index % 256 used for the claimedBitMap bit logic.
Local computedHash in MerkleProof.verify, iteratively recomputed from the leaf and proof elements.
Local proofElement = proof[i] taken from the supplied merkle proof inside the verify loop.

edges.reason: index is packed with account and amount to build the leaf hash node.
account is packed into the leaf hash node.
amount is packed into the leaf hash node.
Caller-supplied merkleProof array is passed into MerkleProof.verify.
Computed leaf node is passed as the leaf argument to MerkleProof.verify.
Stored merkleRoot is used as the root that verify compares against.
claim invokes MerkleProof.verify inside a require guard before paying out.
claim calls isClaimed(index) at the start of execution.
claimedBitMap is read to determine whether the index was already claimed.
index is divided and modulo 256 to derive claimedWordIndex and claimedBitIndex.
claimedBitIndex drives the shift expression (1 << claimedBitIndex) used in the claimedBitMap write.
_setClaimed reads and writes the claimedBitMap mapping.
claim calls _setClaimed(index) before transferring tokens.
Immutable token address is the target contract of the transfer call.
account parameter is the recipient of the token transfer.
amount parameter is the value transferred to the claimant.
claim executes an external token transfer call before finishing its execution.
The external IERC20 transfer could call back into claim/isClaimed, so token state manipulation must be completed before the external call.
Any external caller (msg.sender) can invoke the unpermissioned claim function and influence its execution path.
The boolean result of isClaimed guards the rest of claim via require.
Each proofElement is hashed into the running computedHash during verification.
The boolean returned by MerkleProof.verify is consumed by claim's require statement.

normalization_plan.reason: index is a claim function parameter whose only role is to feed the claim leaf hash and bit-map lookup.
account is a claim function parameter used as the leaf component and transfer recipient.
amount is a claim function parameter used as the leaf component and transferred value.
merkleProof is a claim parameter consumed directly by MerkleProof.verify.
The keccak256 leaf hash is computed in claim solely to be supplied to MerkleProof.verify.
claimedWordIndex/claimedBitIndex exist only to index and shift bits in the claimedBitMap write.
computedHash is the internal accumulator of MerkleProof.verify and has no independent meaning.
proofElement is the per-iteration loop variable that verify hashes into computedHash.
